name: CoolSculpting Elite

lead: CoolSculpting Elite is Allergan's newer fat-freezing system. It cools targeted fat through the skin to reduce small areas such as the chin, abdomen and thighs without surgery.
Reviews report modest reductions in fat thickness and high satisfaction, though data quality is described as low.

paras: Controlled cooling of subcutaneous fat (cryolipolysis) is applied through applicators on the skin over the target area.
Redness, numbness, swelling and bruising are common and usually resolve in weeks. A rare complication, paradoxical adipose hyperplasia, enlarges treated fat and may need surgery.

lead: CoolSculpting Elite is a version of the CoolSculpting cryolipolysis system, a non-invasive procedure that reduces localized subcutaneous fat by controlled cooling. It is made by Allergan Aesthetics, which acquired the CoolSculpting brand from Zeltiq in 2017.[1][2]

The FDA has cleared cryolipolysis for areas including the chin, jawline, arms, flanks, abdomen, thighs and under the buttocks.[1] Reviews report modest fat reductions with high satisfaction, and a rare complication called paradoxical adipose hyperplasia has been described.[1]

paras: Cryolipolysis, often called fat freezing, uses cold applied through the skin to reduce fat in a targeted area. Zeltiq Aesthetics introduced the technology in the US in 2010 as CoolSculpting.[1] CoolSculpting Elite is a later system from Allergan Aesthetics.[2]

A 2015 review of 19 studies reported skinfold reductions of 10.3 to 28.5 percent, and a 2023 review of 18 studies found ultrasound-measured fat reductions of 2.0 to 5.1 mm, with the authors describing safe but modest effects and low data quality.[1]

Redness, numbness, swelling, bruising and mild pain are common and usually resolve within weeks. Paradoxical adipose hyperplasia, in which treated fat enlarges, is reported in about 0.12 to 1.0 percent of cases and may require surgical treatment.[1] A retrospective chart review of 3,262 patients and 18,203 cycles of CoolSculpting and CoolSculpting Elite examined real-world use and adverse events.[3]

A retrospective single-clinic study examined patient satisfaction, recommendation rate and comfort with CoolSculpting Elite.[2] Registered trials include phase 4 studies of CoolSculpting Elite for non-invasive fat reduction (NCT04897867, n=110; NCT07122583, n=102), a 15-person study combining CoolSculpting with CoolTone for the banana roll area, and a facial-contouring study combining several aesthetic treatments (NCT06783621, n=130).[4][5][6][7]

timeline.event: CoolSculpting introduced in the US by Zeltiq.[1]
